assets.name: tree_oak
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a SINGLE editable PNG pixel-art sprite for a 2D top-down dark fantasy game, not a scene or sprite sheet. Subject: one broad oak tree crown seen vertically from directly overhead; no visible trunk, no horizon, no ground tile. Genuine TRANSPARENT background. Low-resolution pixel art enlarged with nearest-neighbor: design as if on a 48x48 pixel grid, chunky crisp square pixel clusters, dark outline, 5 muted colors: deep forest green, moss green, sage highlights, dark blue-green shadow. Organic asymmetric rounded silhouette, subtle top-left light. Center one tree with generous transparent margins, whole silhouette visible. No text, grid, checkered background, watermark, blur, realistic texture, gradients or antialiasing. This sprite must be easy to reduce to 48x48 pixels and edit in Aseprite. Output PNG with actual alpha.

assets.name: ground_moss
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE seamless tileable PNG ground texture for a top-down 2D pixel-art dark fantasy game. Orthographic overhead view of quiet muted mossy grass, no objects, no trees, no rocks, no text, no grid, no border, no lighting gradient. OPAQUE square image, flat low-contrast forest floor in 4 desaturated moss and olive greens. Dominant medium-dark green with sparse tiny subtle grass clusters; do not make noise dense. Design as a 64x64 pixel tile enlarged nearest-neighbor with crisp square pixels. Seamless wrapping on all four edges. No perspective, photographic texture, blur, dithering or shadows.
